description: Deterministic rule-based agronomic and irrigation advisory decision matrix for JalDrishti

suitability_matrix.irrigation_advice: High water-demand crops will accelerate aquifer exhaustion under critical overdraft. Strongly advise shifting to low-water alternatives (e.g., Millets, Pulses, or short-duration Oilseeds). If cultivation is unavoidable, direct-seeded rice (DSR) or alternate wetting and drying (AWD) must be strictly implemented.

canal_context_template.present: Canal infrastructure is present within this block ({canal_length_km:.1f} km, density {canal_density_km_per_km2:.2f} km/km2). Surface water supplies must be utilized where available to eliminate tubewell pumping.
canal_context_template.absent: No canal infrastructure is present within this block (nearest canal is {nearest_canal_distance_km:.1f} km away). Total reliance on deep tubewell pumping poses high hydrological and economic risk.

suitability_matrix.irrigation_advice: Moderate water demand crop under critical groundwater stress. Avoid flood irrigation. Restrict irrigations strictly to critical physiological stages (e.g. CRI and grain formation in wheat; silking in maize). Employ laser land leveling and mulching to suppress evaporative loss.

canal_context_template.present: Canal infrastructure is present within this block ({canal_length_km:.1f} km). Coordinate irrigation turns with canal release schedules where operational.
canal_context_template.absent: Canal infrastructure is not available within this block ({nearest_canal_distance_km:.1f} km away). Strict deficit irrigation and micro-irrigation systems (drip/sprinkler) are recommended.
